items.title: Volunteer
items.description: Join our team of youth activists and volunteers working on advocacy, research, and campaigns. We welcome skills in writing, design, translation, event organizing, and outreach.

items.title: Raise Your Voice
items.description: Follow and share IDCTE's work on social media, write to your local representatives, and help bring international attention to the situation facing Eelam Tamils.

items.title: Partner With Us
items.description: We work with diaspora organizations, human rights groups, and civil society partners. If your organization shares our goals, get in touch about collaborating.

items.title: Support Our Work
items.description: IDCTE is a volunteer-driven organization sustained by the diaspora community. Contact us to learn about current ways to support our advocacy and research work.
